entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: An information element that may be included by the network under specific ESM cause conditions to indicate re-attempt behavior.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: An information element carrying cause values for ESM procedures.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: An information element that carries back-off timer values for network congestion control.

entities.name: ESM cause values condition
entities.description: Condition specifying allowed ESM cause values for including the Re-attempt indicator IE.

entities.name: Back-off timer present condition
entities.description: Condition specifying that Back-off timer value IE is present and ESM cause is not #26.

relations.description: Re-attempt indicator IE inclusion is guarded by specific ESM cause values.
Re-attempt indicator IE inclusion is guarded by Back-off timer value IE presence and ESM cause not being #26.
ESM cause values condition depends on the ESM cause IE.
Back-off timer present condition depends on the Back-off timer value IE.
Back-off timer present condition also depends on ESM cause IE not having value #26.
